meta.name: The Polish Campaign
meta.note: Control polygons are APPROXIMATE reconstructions authored for this scaffold, not surveyed front lines. Refine against Stanford 'Building the New Order' shapefiles.

keyframes.label: Invasion begins. Border battles across Pomerania, Silesia and East Prussia.
Battle of the Border won. The Corridor is cut; the Warta is crossed.
4th Panzer Division reaches the Warsaw suburbs.
Warsaw encircled. The Bzura counterattack is being ground down.
The Soviet Union invades from the east.
Lwów surrenders to the Red Army. German and Soviet forces meet at Brest.
Warsaw capitulates. The Boundary Treaty fixes the German-Soviet line.
The last field army surrenders at Kock. Poland is partitioned.
